intel.title: What's Actually in There?
intel.desc: It's not just dried leaves. Here's a quick look at the top three troublemakers hiding inside.

nicotine.title: Nicotine
nicotine.desc: The hook. It rewires your brain to constantly crave more, making you feel anxious until your next fix.
nicotine.tipDesc: Oral substitutes like mints, sugar-free gum, or deep breathing delay cravings by 10 minutes until nicotine spikes pass.

tar.title: Tar
tar.desc: The sticky stuff. It coats your lungs like paving a road, paralyzing the tiny hairs that keep them clean.
tar.tipDesc: Within 1 to 9 months smoke-free, cilia hairs in your lungs regenerate to sweep away mucus and clean your airway!

co.title: Carbon Monoxide
co.desc: The oxygen thief. It replaces oxygen in your blood, making your heart work overtime just to keep up.
co.tipDesc: In just 12 hours after stopping, carbon monoxide level in your blood drops back to normal!
